# Official Fusion regression fixtures

Source: https://github.com/SuperMartijn642/FusionExamples

- Current examples: `8c9c56ee9bf133bca3aab52620c51c605c986097` (Fusion 1.3 metadata).
- `*-legacy` examples: `eb52d4c4a4c9371300cbb26106e9aa58a58eecb0` (Fusion model-loader metadata).
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 Martijn van den Brand. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Files are copied without modification; unrelated README/images were omitted.

| Fixture | Upstream directory |
| --- | --- |
| glass, glass-legacy | Pieced Layout Connected Glass |
| compact, compact-legacy | Compact Layout Steel Beam |
| full, full-legacy | Full Layout Lapis Connecting Texture |
| animated | Animated Connecting Texture |
| grass | Better Grass |
| random | Random Tuff Bricks Texture |
| overlay | Grass Block Overflow |

`SHA256SUMS.json` records the copied fixture bytes. These are test-only assets and
are not bundled in the Android app or generated packs unless explicitly supplied
as conversion input.

## Independent layout oracle

`layout-oracle.json` records source-tile indices for each of the 256 neighbor masks
(bits L, DL, D, DR, R, UR, U, UL). It was generated by executing the unmodified
`getTilePos` methods of Fusion's Full, Compact, Simple, Horizontal and Vertical
layout handlers at commit `0a8b8a9198ed79fc8c4f898d53bba79cda76752b`:
https://github.com/SuperMartijn642/Fusion/tree/0a8b8a9198ed79fc8c4f898d53bba79cda76752b/src/main/java/com/supermartijn642/fusion/texture/types/connecting/layouts

Only the factual lookup results are stored; Fusion implementation source is not
vendored. To regenerate with a local Fusion checkout and JDK, run
`python3 tests/generate_fusion_oracle.py /path/to/Fusion`.
Pieced tests use the published eight-entry corner truth table and asymmetric
pixel-coordinate images to verify each quarter independently.
